Container.Name: band3-bot
Container.Overview: Discord song requests for band3 (the PC recompilation of Rock Band 3). People on your Discord server request custom songs from RhythmVerse with /request, and browse the band's song library on a web page with /browse; every paired band3 downloads each request the next time it's online.[br][br]Networking: band3 finds the bot by a LAN broadcast on UDP 21072, which Docker's default bridge network doesn't pass into a container. This template uses br0 (the container gets its own LAN IP; set one under Fixed IP address, or let DHCP give one). Host networking also works. With bridge, discovery won't work and each game needs requests_server set by hand.[br][br]Put the browse page behind your reverse proxy and set Public URL to that address.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Browse page and band3's API. With br0 or Host networking this is the port on the container's own address; keep it the same as PORT.

Config.Name: Discovery port
Config.Description: band3's LAN discovery broadcast (needs br0 or Host networking)

Config.Name: Discord token
Config.Description: Discord Developer Portal > your application > Bot > Reset Token

Config.Name: Discord server ID
Config.Description: Right-click your server > Copy Server ID (needs Developer Mode); commands appear there at once

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The browse page's address through your reverse proxy, e.g. https://band3.example.com, for /browse links

Config.Name: Bot name
Config.Description: What band3 shows in Settings > Online

Config.Name: Requester role
Config.Description: Optional: only members with this Discord role (name or ID) can request

Config.Name: Approver role
Config.Description: Optional: requests wait for an approver's button; approvers (and the server owner) pair games

Config.Name: Per-user limit
Config.Description: Requests per user per 24 hours; approvers aren't limited; 0 = no limit

Config.Name: Share album art
Config.Description: Ask games for their songs' album art for the browse page

Config.Name: Advertise URL
Config.Description: What band3 is told to connect to; blank = http://(the container's LAN address):PORT

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The port the bot listens on inside the container

Config.Name: Secret
Config.Description: Signs /browse links; blank = generated once and kept in /config
